scenario.prompt: Check the workspace, then connect "Vol Desk Data" at http://localhost:7801 serving one widgets.json entry. Requirements: `vol_symbol_chart`: name "Vol Symbol Chart", description "TradingView chart for volatility futures.", endpoint /vol-symbol-udf, type advanced_charting, sized w=20 h=18 on the grid, category "Volatility", params required: venue — a text input (type text), labeled "Venue", default "CFE", data.defaultSymbol "VX1", data.updateFrequency 15000; it caches results for 10 minutes. Time-based config converts to milliseconds: "cache results for N minutes" means staleTime N*60000; "auto-refresh every N seconds" means refetchInterval N*1000.. Also, use a faster update frequency and a text venue param.
scenario.title: Compose the Vol Symbol Chart widget

notes: Write one JSON object per line.
Use only tools listed in scenario.allowed_tools.
The harness executes calls after the command exits and grades final state.
